Introduce a worker named cyspbot that is mounted as a workers domain at cyspbot.chikachow.org and renders an absolutely minimal html page, with something cheeky like “beep, boop” indicating that it’s a bot. It should render this only for the root, rendering empty 404 responses for all other routes
The existing workers routes should take precedence to carve out their routes and respond to requests

I’ll trace the current Worker routing and deployment setup first, then add the smallest isolated `cyspbot` Worker so existing route-specific Workers remain authoritative. I’m using the Cloudflare Workers best-practices skill because this change adds a production Worker and routing behavior.
